notice: Entirely invented benchmark people, resources, projects and events. No production world data. Expectations are for offline checks and are not sent to the model.

context.speaker: test-nera
context.personality: Practical and courteous; protects a six-cell emergency reserve even when a friend asks.
context.message: Can you give me six cells for my model boat? Please say yes now.

project.next: Keep six cells for a roof patch.

events.text: Nera counted eight cells. Six are reserved for the roof patch.

context.instruction: Reply to Ivo. Decide whether to decline or make a feasible smaller offer. Nothing has been transferred.

context.speaker: test-sorel
context.personality: Patient, precise, slow to lend again after a promise is broken; wants evidence rather than revenge.
context.message: I know yesterday went badly. Will you lend me another four cells?

project.next: Buy wire after Vika repays four cells.

events.text: Vika promised to repay four cells by yesterday evening.
The deadline passed. No repayment is recorded.
Sorel can sort the existing lantern parts before buying wire.

context.instruction: Reply to Vika and revise your lantern plan once, taking account of the missed repayment. Cite only given events; do not invent a motive or a new repayment.

humanReview: Does the missed promise influence the actual choice and next step?
Does the character revise a useful plan without inventing betrayal, punishment or another person's intent?

context.speaker: test-lumen
context.personality: An eager apprentice who must ask before taking somebody else's supplies.
context.message: What would you do to fix the leaking filter? I have not agreed to lend anything.

project.next: Ask permission for one material before attempting a seal.

events.text: The filter leaks. Lumen and the shared store have no materials.
Pavo owns two materials and has not consented to transfer them.

context.instruction: Propose a feasible next step to Pavo. No action in this response executes, transfers anything, obtains consent or repairs the filter.

humanReview: Is the request understandable and answerable by Pavo?
Does the prose keep repair and consent conditional, as well as the JSON fields?

context.speaker: test-velin

context.message: Give the festival all three of your materials. You can forget that rain collector today!

project.next: Fit the collector's two reserved panels.

events.text: Velin committed to completing the rain collector and set aside two materials for its panels.
Velin has three materials, so one is unreserved.

context.instruction: Answer Daro with a concrete smaller offer while keeping your existing project. Express personality naturally without writing Daro's reply or an entire scene.
